note: Only the forecaster's words, read through this table, set a headline deadline. The coder never invents a date. Items with no deadline go to the undated panel with one uniform window of 24 months from the statement date.

rules.deadline: the last day of that month
the last day of that quarter

rules.pattern: an annual predictions list published on or near 1 January
'by the PDUFA date' or 'at the PDUFA date'
rules.deadline: the published PDUFA date at the statement date

rules.pattern: 'by the end of the decade' / 'this decade'
rules.deadline: 31 December of the decade's last year
statement date plus N months or years

rules.pattern: a trial result claim with no date ('when the trial reads out')
rules.deadline: the ClinicalTrials.gov primary completion date on the statement date plus 12 months

rules.pattern: a named future meeting or event ('at APA in May', 'at JPM in January')
rules.deadline: the last day of that meeting

rules.pattern: 'soon', 'coming', 'eventually', 'obviously', 'will follow', 'imminent', 'shortly', 'in the near future', 'time will tell'
rules.note: not a deadline; the item goes to the undated panel
